Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dsprrr 0.1.0

Initial CRAN release. dsprrr is experimental and its API may still evolve.

Core programming model

  • Declare LLM tasks with typed inputs, outputs, and instructions using signature(), input(), with_instructions(), append_instructions(), and with_reasoning().
  • Turn signatures into runnable programs with module(), chain_of_thought() (supporting "rationale", "plan", and "native" reasoning modes), multi_chain_comparison(), react() (including tool-loop finalization = "submit"), rag_module(), module_fn(), and code-executing modules (program_of_thought(), code_act()).
  • Compose and harden programs with pipeline() / %>>%, step(), best_of_n(), refine(), ensemble(), and output assertions (with_assertions(), assert_output(), suggest_output()).
  • Run programs on single inputs, vectors, or data frames with run(), run_dataset(), concurrency_control() (sequential, ellmer parallel, and mirai backends), run_async(), run_stream(), and stream_async().
  • Manage chats, portable conversation histories, and two-tier response caching with dsp_configure(), with_lm(), local_lm(), conversation_history(), save_history() / load_history(), configure_cache(), cache_stats(), and dsprrr_sitrep().

Evaluation and optimization

  • Measure program quality with evaluate(), built-in metrics (metric_exact_match(), metric_f1(), metric_contains(), metric_field_match(), metric_custom(), metric_threshold(), metric_with_feedback(), metric_with_trace()), and vitals bridges (as_vitals_solver(), as_vitals_task(), as_dsprrr_metric()).
  • Optimize demonstrations, instructions, and request settings with compile() and teleprompters (LabeledFewShot(), BootstrapFewShot(), BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch(), KNNFewShot(), COPRO(), MIPROv2(), GEPA(), SIMBA(), GridSearchTeleprompter(), BetterTogether()) or optimize_grid().
  • Inspect results, traces, prompts, and spend with optimization_result(), optimization_summary(), best_params(), best_demos(), top_trials(), config_diff(), get_last_prompt(), inspect_history(), export_traces(), summarize_traces(), and session_cost().

Persistence and integrations

  • Save and restore versioned program artifacts with save_program(), load_program(), program_artifact(), program_artifact_id(), pin_module_config(), restore_module_config(), and export_module_code().
  • Integrate with the wider R ecosystem via as_ellmer_tool(), ragnar_tool(), create_search_tool(), use_dsprrr_template(), validate_workflow(), llm_predict() (parsnip), and dials parameters (temperature(), top_p(), reasoning_effort()).

Experimental features

  • Recursive Language Models (rlm_module(), rlm(), mcp_repl_runner(), r_code_runner(), run_demo()), whole-program optimization (flex()), calibrated decision outputs (with_decisions(), decision_bool(), decision_score(), decision_choice(), ReAnchor()), and meta/agentic optimizers (Omni(), AutoResearch(), MetaHarness()).

Requirements

  • Requires R >= 4.1.0 and ellmer >= 0.5.0.
  • Installing from source requires a C compiler (used for exact filesystem identity checks in local persistence guards).
